news.analysis: Despite being without Puka Nacua (to go along with Davante Adams still being sidelined), Stafford still managed to make it work in a blowout win for the Rams. He tossed touchdowns to Xavier Smith, Davis Allen and Tyler Higbee. The Rams will look to get healthier heading into their bye next week.
news.contents: Matthew Stafford completed 18-of-26 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and one interception in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals.

news.contents: Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford is watching his teammates get hurt left and right, which has made him a risky fantasy football option for Week 10 against the Arizona Cardinals. The Rams will be without Puka Nacua (knee) and Davante Adams (hamstring) this week, marking the first time in 2026 that both receivers have been absent for the same game. He was targeted five times in the passing game, but only recorded two receptions for nine yards (4.5 yards per catch). On Sunday, Allgeier carried the ball five times for 14 yards and failed to haul in his lone target in the loss. The five touches in the backfield were the fewest for Allgeier since Week 5.
